description: Paste a README, PR description, spec or memo plus the Checkbooth results it relies on. We check every number in the text against those signed results and flag overclaim phrases (for example "verified across all conditions", "guaranteed", "certified"). Deterministic, no AI. Signed receipt.

results.description: Full Checkbooth results exactly as returned (each carries its receiptToken).

name: verify_claims_against_receipts
